label: Diagram 32
caption: Diagram 32 Free areas of permanently open air vents for gas appliance installations (other than decorative fuel effect fires or flueless appliances)
description: Diagram 32, titled 'Free areas of permanently open air vents for gas appliance installations (other than decorative fuel effect fires or flueless appliances)', is a table with header columns 'Open flued' and 'Room sealed'. Each data cell contains a plan (top view) of a room, drawn as a rectangular outline with a small inner compartment at the right holding the appliance; in the open-flued cells and the lower two room-sealed cells the walls show gaps marked by letters. In the top row only, an arrow points to the appliance, labelled 'Open-flued appliance' in the open-flued cell and 'Room-sealed appliance' in the room-sealed cell. The three rows are headed 'Appliance in a room or space', 'Appliance in an appliance compartment ventilated via an adjoining room or space', and 'Appliance in an appliance compartment ventilated direct to outside'. The lettered gaps carry equations: 'A = 500mm² per kW input (net)', 'B = 1000mm² per kW input (net)', 'C = 2000mm² per kW input', 'F = 1000mm² per kW input (net)', 'G = F', 'D = 500mm² per kW input (net)', 'E = 1000mm² per kW input (net)', 'H = 500mm² per kW input (net)', 'I = H'; the first room-sealed cell reads 'No vent needed'. Below, a Notes section gives five numbered points, the last stating that in older dwellings with air permeability more than 5.0 m³/h/m² the first 7kW(net) can be ignored.
